The keys on my work laptop started chipping because they're painted, so I really like that these keys are not painted and won't be prone to the same issue. The laptop is quite fast and the 30+ hour battery life is unmatched. The charger is ultra-small and uses USB-C, which is perfect.

For the things I wasn't a fan of: I didn't like that the laptop required a Microsoft account for setup and I found that the charger got unbearably hot during setup. The keys are made of recycled plastic, which may seem nice in theory, but makes the keys look cheap to me. Most importantly, the quality of the screen/graphics seems really low. Overall, I think this is a solid laptop for basic usage, but would not be good for anyone who is passionate about visuals or dealing with graphics.

I highly recommend this laptop.
